submission.natural_language_explanation: In its g+/u- sign regime this negative pole fires on a '.' token that terminates a grammatically complete declarative clause, acting as a retrospective clause-closure signal (single-token ablation of the final content word or the period removes ~0.5-1.2 of strength; integrated-gradients mass sits on the period plus the preceding ~5 tokens, mean distance 3.2). The same '.' fires weakly or not at all when it ends a fragment ('before the.' 0.02 vs complete 0.24), when the terminal is '?'/'!' (0.73->0.14), on abbreviation-internal periods, on decimal points whose prefix is not a complete clause ('I have 3.' ~0.0 vs 'The value is 3.' 0.46), or in very short clauses ('She arrived yesterday.' 0.0); strength scales with clause weight (0.24 at 6-12 tokens up to 0.73+ at 13). A separate g-/u+ regime firing mid-sentence on famous-name tokens (Moon, Seine, Neil, world) is a distinct mechanism outside this claim.
